steps.text: Onions smell strong! We'll use that smell to tell acids from bases.
Let's start with an acid — tap "Tamarind Water".
Now tap "Mix Together" to mix it with the chopped onion.
Take a sniff 👃 — the strong onion smell stays. Acids keep the smell!
Now let's try a base — tap "Baking Soda".
This time the smell fades away — bases neutralise it.
That's the trick: acids keep the onion smell, bases remove it. You did it! 🎉

coach.mission: Use smell to tell acids from bases.
whenStuck: Pick a solution, then tap “Mix Together”.
Acids keep the onion smell; bases remove it — try both.
whenWrong: Acids keep the strong onion smell; bases make it fade — check what you mixed.
If the smell stayed, you added an acid; if it faded, a base.
whenCorrect: Right — you used your nose like a scientist!
Acids keep the smell, bases remove it. Nice.
coach.done: You've seen how olfactory indicators work. Try the other option, or move on.
